name: Kobayashi Clash of Conquest
storyline:
In an age where dragons ruled the skies and men cowered in the shadows, one warlord dared to rise.

Kobayashi, a legendary strategist from a forgotten era, is torn from his world and cast into a realm consumed by dragonfire and chaos. Ancient factions wage endless war over territories scorched by winged beasts the size of mountains.

With nothing but his wits and an iron will, Kobayashi must build his empire from the ground up : gathering resources, fortifying his stronghold, and forging alliances with unlikely warriors. But survival is only the beginning. To conquer this world, he must do what no one has done before: command the dragons themselves.

Build. Expand. Conquer.

Kobayashi Clash Of Conquest is a real-time strategy game where every decision shapes the fate of your empire. Construct your base, train your armies, and crush your enemies : before they crush you.

The dragons chose this world. You will own it.
summary:
Kobayashi Clan of Conquest is a base-building and defense game set in a fantasy world populated by dragons.

Starting from a humble village, you develop your domain level by level to forge a true empire. Build gold mines, lumber mills, mystical laboratories, and defensive towers, all while strategically managing your resources.
